Features.WorldMap.Description: Provides options for restricting the usage of the world map.
Features.WorldMap.DisableWorldMapKeyBind: Toggle whether players can use the default 'M' key to open the world map.
Features.WorldMap.DisableMiniMapKeyBindi: Toggle whether players can use the 'F6' key to toggle the mini-map.
Features.WorldMap.WipeWorldMapAtLogin.De: Clear the player's local world map data when they log in.
Features.WorldMap.WipeWorldMapOnDeath.De: Clear the player's local world map data when they die.
Toggle whether players can enable the on-screen coordinates HUD.
Features.WorldMap.DisableCoordinatesOnHo: Disable coordinates when the player hovers over the mini-map.
Features.WorldMap.DisableMiniMapScrollin: Toggle whether players can click and drag to scroll the mini-map.
Features.WorldMap.MinimumZoomLevel.Descr: Set the minimum zoom level allowed for the mini-map.
Features.WorldMap.MaximumZoomLevel.Descr: Set the maximum zoom level allowed for the mini-map.
Features.WorldMap.DefaultZoomLevel.Descr: Set the default zoom level the mini-map opens with.
Features.WorldMap.EnsureMiniMapActive.De: Force the mini-map to be visible by default for players.
